name: ANSI/IEEE ac relay coil symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for ac relay coil, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The AC relay operating form belongs to a specified alternating-current control supply. Its coil rating includes the applicable voltage and frequency; contact ratings are a separate specification and may concern a different circuit.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify the AC control source feeding the coil.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: AC coil suitability does not establish a contact's permitted DC switching duty.
